Create a wallet with a 12-word English recovery phrase, or restore an existing English BIP39 phrase. Choose the same network when restoring.
Unlock to verify your saved wallet and view its receiving address.
A saved wallet needs recovery verification. Unlock to check it.

Write every word in order and keep the backup private. Anyone with these words can control the wallet. Next, you will re-enter the phrase before saving. Leaving the app or waiting ten minutes closes setup.
Enter the phrase from your written backup using the keyboard below. Keep the words in their original order.
That phrase did not match. Check your written backup and enter it again.
Enter your English BIP39 recovery phrase using the keyboard below. This version does not support an extra passphrase. Leaving the app clears your entry.
That recovery phrase was not valid. Check the words and their order, then try again.
